entities.name: Query protein 322 aa
observations: Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt O30762 from Pseudomonas putida.
Sequence length is 322 aa; predicted molecular weight 35.49 kDa and pI 6.81.
Contains an IPPT domain (PF01715.24) spanning residues 41–293.

entities.name: O30762
observations: Catalyzes transfer of a dimethylallyl group onto adenine 37 of selected tRNAs, producing N6-(dimethylallyl)adenosine (i6A).

entities.name: tRNA i6A37 formation
observations: Adenosine(37) in tRNA + dimethylallyl diphosphate → N6-dimethylallyladenosine(37) in tRNA + diphosphate.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Mg2+ is reported as a cofactor for the tRNA dimethylallyltransferase reaction.
